text:
Maria Chen: Quick reminder — PolarisAI onboarding kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda: intros, data access, integration plan, success criteria. Need owners for tech demo, enablement session, and renewal-risk flags. @Devon @Nora can you take tech & enablement? :calendar:

Devon Patel: I can run the tech intro and demo the sample integration. Will need engineer from their side and our sample dataset access. Asking for an env by EOD today.

Nora Singh: I'll own enablement + training materials. Planning a 45m deep-dive + 30m office hours next week. Will share slide draft after today's stand.

Liam O'Rourke: I'll handle stakeholder intro and success criteria alignment. Can we agree on 3 measurable success metrics for the 30/60/90? Suggest: 1) latency P95 <= 500ms on dedicated flow; 2) avg cost per 1k tokens <= $X; 3) accuracy on routing eval >= 92%.

Maria Chen: +1 on metrics. Liam can you draft the acceptance criteria doc? Put it in the PolarisAI workspace. Also flagging renewal-risk signals: low seat adoption by week 6, repeated infra errors, or missed SLAs.

Devon Patel: For env: their eng lead said SSO + VPC peering. I'll DM infra to prioritize. If peering not ready, fallback to demo with sanitized sample and local proxy.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Kickoff meeting scheduled: PolarisAI - kickoff — 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Add calendar link: https://cal.redwood/meet/abc123

Nora Singh: Slide outline: onboarding goals, feature map, training cadence, Q&A, next steps. Will include 'how we measure success' slide with Liam's criteria.

Maria Chen: Owners summary: Tech - Devon; Enablement - Nora; Stakeholder success - Liam; I'll handle cadence and health checks. Can each owner drop a 1-line commitment here by 5pm? :white_check_mark:

Devon Patel: Commitment: Deliver demo plan + test env checklist by 5pm.

Nora Singh: Commitment: Draft slides + office hours schedule by 5pm.

Liam O'Rourke: Commitment: Draft 30/60/90 acceptance criteria and a renewal-risk register by 5pm.

Maria Chen: Great — thanks team. I'll consolidate and post meeting prep 1hr before kickoff. If anything blocks env or data, ping #eng-oncall and me. --Maria
